decisions.reason: As a core safety-shoe line that gained its own website page in 2024, it appears to meet an aspiration formed from the firm’s past successful footwear lines, so no problemistic search is triggered.

With only a brief website mention and no clear evidence of above-aspiration results, there is some problemistic search, but organizational slack allows the firm to carry this uncertain insole while it evaluates further.

Like Product B, its limited visibility suggests results may be below aspirations, yet slack and the possible fit with the firm’s workwear accessories mean it is kept while performance remains uncertain.
This ergonomic safety-shoe series has had its own page since launch, signaling sustained management attention and results close to or above aspirations, so drop risk is very low.
The move from a brief mention to a dedicated page in 2024 indicates growing acceptance relative to aspirations, and the niche fire/rescue segment justifies retention.
As the flagship, it is shown on the home page and has a concrete positive customer result, placing it well above aspirations and making discontinuation highly unlikely.
